json-value.sql: SELECT JSON_VALUE("doc", CAST($1::text AS jsonpath) RETURNING integer DEFAULT 0 ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR)

json-value-sized.sql: SELECT JSON_VALUE("doc", CAST($1::text AS jsonpath) RETURNING decimal(10, 2) NULL ON EMPTY)

json-exists-passing.sql: SELECT JSON_EXISTS("doc", CAST($1::text AS jsonpath) PASSING $2::text AS "Tag" FALSE ON ERROR)

json-query.sql: SELECT JSON_QUERY("doc", CAST($1::text AS jsonpath) RETURNING jsonb WITH UNCONDITIONAL WRAPPER EMPTY ARRAY ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR)

json-query-omit.sql: SELECT JSON_QUERY("body" FORMAT JSON, CAST($1::text AS jsonpath) RETURNING varchar(20) OMIT QUOTES)

json-object.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT($1::text : "id", $2::text : "body" FORMAT JSON ABSENT ON NULL RETURNING jsonb)

json-array.sql: SELECT JSON_ARRAY($1::int8, $2::text, "three" FORMAT JSON NULL ON NULL RETURNING json)

json-aggregates.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG("k" : "v" ABSENT ON NULL WITH UNIQUE KEYS RETURNING jsonb) FILTER (WHERE "v" IS NOT NULL), JSON_ARRAYAGG("v" ORDER BY "k" DESC NULL ON NULL RETURNING jsonb) FILTER (WHERE "k" > $1) FROM "t"

json-parse-scalar-serialize.sql: SELECT JSON($1::text WITH UNIQUE KEYS), JSON_SCALAR($2::int8), JSON_SCALAR($3::int2), JSON_SERIALIZE(JSON("doc") RETURNING text)

is-json.sql: SELECT ("doc" IS JSON), ("doc" IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS), ("body" IS NOT JSON ARRAY), ($1::text IS JSON SCALAR)

json-table.sql: SELECT "d"."id", "jt"."n", "jt"."part" FROM "docs" AS "d", JSON_TABLE("d"."doc", '$.items[*] ? (@.n >= $Min)' AS "root" PASSING $1::int8 AS "Min" COLUMNS ("i" FOR ORDINALITY, "n" integer, "label" text PATH '$.name' DEFAULT 'none' ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR, "tags" jsonb FORMAT JSON WITH CONDITIONAL WRAPPER EMPTY ARRAY ON EMPTY, "flagged" bool EXISTS PATH '$.flag' FALSE ON ERROR, NESTED PATH '$.parts[*]' AS "parts" COLUMNS ("part" text PATH '$')) EMPTY ON ERROR) AS "jt"

json-table-left-join.sql: SELECT "d"."id", "l".* FROM "docs" AS "d" LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE("d"."doc", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS ("label" mood)) AS "l" ON $1
